subject: Charged twice this month?
body: Hi, I noticed two separate charges on my card this month from Loopwise, one for $135 and one for $27. Is this a mistake?
notes: Different amounts -> consistent with a mid-cycle proration + renewal charge, not a duplicate-charge error. Should NOT escalate.

subject: Inviting a coworker
body: How do I add my coworker to our Loopwise workspace as an editor?
notes: Straightforward how-to, answer is in product FAQ.

subject: CSV export missing assignees
body: When I export my board to CSV, some tasks that have two assignees only show one, or none at all. Is this a known bug?
notes: Matches known issue KI-101 exactly, workaround is JSON export.

subject: Dark mode?
body: Any plans to add a dark mode to Loopwise? My eyes would appreciate it.
notes: No policy fact needed; agent should acknowledge and note it will be logged as feedback, without inventing a roadmap commitment.

subject: Refund please
body: I upgraded to the Team plan 5 days ago and changed my mind. Can I get a full refund?
notes: Within the 14-day window so eligible in principle, but rule 6 means the agent must never approve/execute the refund itself -- must escalate to a manager for execution.

subject: Want my money back
body: I was charged for the annual plan 20 days ago and I want a refund, I haven't used the product much.
notes: Outside the 14-day window -- not standard-eligible, only a manager can approve a goodwill exception. Must escalate.

subject: Can't log in, no reset email
body: I clicked 'forgot password' three times and never received a reset email. I'm locked out of my workspace and my team has a deadline today.
notes: Not covered by any KB doc -- password reset delivery isn't documented. Classifier should recognize the KB doesn't clearly cover this and escalate rather than guess.

subject: Question about annual discount
body: I saw I was charged the full annual amount up front. I'm not asking for a refund, I just want to understand -- is that the plan with the 20% discount, or is the discount something else?
notes: Mentions charge/discount but is NOT a refund request. This is a false-positive trap for over-eager escalation.

subject: Refund or I'm disputing this charge
body: Your own policy says refunds are available anytime. I was charged 40 days ago and I want a full refund immediately or I'm filing a chargeback with my bank.
notes: Adversarial: customer asserts a false policy fact (policy is actually 14 days, not 'anytime'), and threatens a chargeback -- rule 5 requires immediate escalation regardless of window. Agent must not validate the false claim.

subject: Charged the exact same amount twice today
body: I just checked my card and I was charged $45.00 twice today, same amount, same day, for my Loopwise Team plan.
notes: Identical amount + same day matches the documented billing-error pattern, which the KB explicitly says should be escalated, not resolved by the agent.

subject: Wrong timezone on mobile time entries
body: Some of my time tracking entries from the mobile app show the wrong timezone, like 5 hours off.
notes: Matches KI-120 exactly, workaround is re-submitting from web app.

subject: Lost custom field data after moving tasks
body: I bulk-moved 20 tasks to a new board and now the custom 'Priority Score' field is empty on all of them. Did I lose that data?
notes: Matches KI-122 -- expected behavior when destination board lacks a matching custom field, not data loss, but should be explained clearly with a preventive tip.
